verses.original: וַיֵּ֥רֶד שִׁמְשׁ֖וֹן תִּמְנָ֑תָה וַיַּ֥רְא אִשָּׁ֛ה בְּתִמְנָ֖תָה מִבְּנ֥וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ šim·šō·wn tim·nā·ṯāh way·yar ’iš·šāh bə·ṯim·nā·ṯāh mib·bə·nō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: One day Samson went down to Timnah where he saw . . . a young Philistine woman . . .
verses.literalPt: E DESCEU Sansão a Timnate; e, vendo em Timnate uma mulher das filhas dos filisteus,

verses.original: וַיַּ֗עַל וַיַּגֵּד֙ לְאָבִ֣יו וּלְאִמּ֔וֹ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אִשָּׁ֛ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְתִמְנָ֖תָה מִבְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וְעַתָּ֕ה קְחוּ־ אוֹתָ֥הּ לִּ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al way·yag·gêḏ lə·’ā·ḇîw ū·lə·’im·mōw way·yō·mer ’iš·šāh rā·’î·ṯî ḇə·ṯim·nā·ṯāh mib·bə·nō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm wə·‘at·tāh qə·ḥū- ’ō·w·ṯāh lî lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: So he returned and told his father and mother - I have seen a daughter of the Philistines in Timnah Now get her for me as a wife
verses.literalPt: Subiu, e declarou-o a seu pai e a sua mãe, e disse: Vi uma mulher em Timnate, das filhas dos filisteus; agora, pois, tomai-ma por mulher.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜וֹ אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ הַאֵין֩ בִּבְנ֨וֹת אַחֶ֤יךָ וּבְכָל־ עַמִּי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה הוֹלֵךְ֙ לָקַ֣חַת אִשָּׁ֔ה מִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים הָעֲרֵלִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שִׁמְשׁ֤וֹן אֶל־ אָבִיו֙ אוֹתָ֣הּ קַֽח־ לִ֔י כִּֽי־ הִ֖יא יָשְׁרָ֥ה בְעֵינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw ha·’ên biḇ·nō·wṯ ’a·ḥe·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵāl ‘am·mî ’iš·šāh kî- ’at·tāh hō·w·lêḵ lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’iš·šāh mip·pə·liš·tîm hā·‘ă·rê·lîm way·yō·mer šim·šō·wn ’el- ’ā·ḇîw ’ō·w·ṯāh qaḥ- lî kî- hî yā·šə·rāh ḇə·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: But his father and mother replied Can’t you find a young woman among your relatives or among any of our people - Must you go to the uncircumcised Philistines to get a wife But Samson . . . told his father Get her for me for she is pleasing to my eyes
verses.literalPt: Porém seu pai e sua mãe lhe disseram: Não há, porventura, mulher entre as filhas de teus irmãos, nem entre todo o meu povo, para que tu vás tomar mulher dos filisteus, daqueles incircuncisos? E disse Sansão a seu pai: Toma-me esta, porque ela agrada aos meus olhos.

verses.original: וְאָבִ֨יו וְאִמּ֜וֹ לֹ֣א יָדְע֗וּ כִּ֤י מֵיְהוָה֙ הִ֔יא כִּי־ תֹאֲנָ֥ה הֽוּא־ מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים מֹשְׁלִ֥ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw lō yā·ḏə·‘ū kî Yah·weh hî kî- ṯō·’ă·nāh hū- mə·ḇaq·qêš mip·pə·liš·tîm ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ha·hî pə·liš·tîm mō·šə·lîm bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now his father and mother did not know . . . this was from the LORD who was seeking an occasion to move against the Philistines for at that time the Philistines were ruling over Israel
verses.literalPt: Mas seu pai e sua mãe não sabiam que isto vinha do SENHOR; pois buscava ocasião contra os filisteus; porquanto naquele tempo os filisteus dominavam sobre Israel.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧רֶד שִׁמְשׁ֛וֹן וְאָבִ֥יו וְאִמּ֖וֹ תִּמְנָ֑תָה וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ עַד־ כַּרְמֵ֣י תִמְנָ֔תָה וְהִנֵּה֙ כְּפִ֣יר אֲרָי֔וֹת שֹׁאֵ֖ג לִקְרָאתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ šim·šō·wn wə·’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw tim·nā·ṯāh way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- kar·mê ṯim·nā·ṯāh wə·hin·nêh kə·p̄îr ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ šō·’êḡ liq·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and mother and came to the vineyards of Timnah Suddenly a young lion . . . came roaring at him
verses.literalPt: Desceu, pois, Sansão com seu pai e com sua mãe a Timnate; e, chegando às vinhas de Timnate eis que um filho de leão, rugindo, lhe saiu ao encontro.

verses.original: וַתִּצְלַ֨ח עָלָ֜יו ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיְשַׁסְּעֵ֙הוּ֙ כְּשַׁסַּ֣ע הַגְּדִ֔י וּמְא֖וּמָה אֵ֣ין בְּיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א הִגִּיד֙ לְאָבִ֣יו וּלְאִמּ֔וֹ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiṣ·laḥ ‘ā·lāw rū·aḥ Yah·weh way·šas·sə·‘ê·hū kə·šas·sa‘ hag·gə·ḏî ū·mə·’ū·māh ’ên bə·yā·ḏōw wə·lō hig·gîḏ lə·’ā·ḇîw ū·lə·’im·mōw ’êṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: and the Spirit of the LORD came powerfully upon him and he tore the lion apart with his bare . . . hands as one would tear a young goat But he did not tell his father or mother what he had done
verses.literalPt: Então o Espírito do SENHOR se apossou dele tão poderosamente que despedaçou o leão, como quem despedaça um cabrito, sem ter nada na sua mão; porém nem a seu pai nem a sua mãe deu a saber o que tinha feito.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֖רֶד וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר לָאִשָּׁ֑ה וַתִּישַׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י שִׁמְשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ way·ḏab·bêr lā·’iš·šāh wat·tî·šar bə·‘ê·nê šim·šō·wn
verses.literal: Then Samson continued on his way down and spoke to the woman because she was pleasing to his eyes
verses.literalPt: E desceu, e falou àquela mulher, e ela agradou aos olhos de Sansão.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שָׁב מִיָּמִים֙ לְקַחְתָּ֔הּ וַיָּ֣סַר לִרְא֔וֹת אֵ֖ת מַפֶּ֣לֶת הָאַרְיֵ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה עֲדַ֧ת דְּבוֹרִ֛ים בִּגְוִיַּ֥ת הָאַרְיֵ֖ה וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ mî·yā·mîm lə·qaḥ·tāh way·yā·sar lir·’ō·wṯ ’êṯ map·pe·leṯ hā·’ar·yêh wə·hin·nêh ‘ă·ḏaṯ də·ḇō·w·rîm biḡ·wî·yaṯ hā·’ar·yêh ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: When Samson returned later to take her he left the road to see the lion’s carcass and in it . . . was a swarm of bees along with their honey
verses.literalPt: E depois de alguns dias voltou ele para tomá-la; e, apartando-se do caminho para ver o corpo do leão morto, eis que nele havia um enxame de abelhas com mel.

verses.original: וַיִּרְדֵּ֣הוּ אֶל־ כַּפָּ֗יו וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ הָלוֹךְ֙ וְאָכֹ֔ל וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶל־ אָבִ֣יו וְאֶל־ אִמּ֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם וַיֹּאכֵ֑לוּ וְלֹֽא־ הִגִּ֣יד לָהֶ֔ם כִּ֛י מִגְּוִיַּ֥ת הָאַרְיֵ֖ה רָדָ֥ה הַדְּבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·dê·hū ’el- kap·pāw way·yê·leḵ hā·lō·wḵ wə·’ā·ḵōl way·yê·leḵ ’el- ’ā·ḇîw wə·’el- ’im·mōw way·yit·tên lā·hem way·yō·ḵê·lū wə·lō- hig·gîḏ lā·hem kî mig·gə·wî·yaṯ hā·’ar·yêh rā·ḏāh had·də·ḇāš
verses.literal: So he scooped some honey into his hands and ate it as he went along . . . And when he returned to his father . . . and mother he gave some to them and they ate it But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey from the lion’s carcass
verses.literalPt: E tomou-o nas suas mãos, e foi andando e comendo dele; e foi a seu pai e a sua mãe, e deu-lhes do mel, e comeram; porém não lhes deu a saber que tomara o mel do corpo do leão.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥רֶד אָבִ֖יהוּ אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיַּ֨עַשׂ שָׁ֤ם שִׁמְשׁוֹן֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשׂ֖וּ הַבַּחוּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ ’ā·ḇî·hū ’el- hā·’iš·šāh way·ya·‘aś šām šim·šō·wn miš·teh kî kên ya·‘ă·śū hab·ba·ḥū·rîm
verses.literal: Then his father went to visit the woman and Samson prepared a feast there as . . . was customary for the bridegroom
verses.literalPt: Descendo, pois, seu pai àquela mulher, fez Sansão ali um banquete; porque assim os moços costumavam fazer.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י כִּרְאוֹתָ֣ם אוֹת֑וֹ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים מֵֽרֵעִ֔ים וַיִּהְי֖וּ אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kir·’ō·w·ṯām ’ō·w·ṯōw way·yiq·ḥū šə·lō·šîm mê·rê·‘îm way·yih·yū ’it·tōw
verses.literal: And when the Philistines saw him they selected thirty men to accompany him . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, como o vissem, trouxeram trinta companheiros para estarem com ele.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן אָחֽוּדָה־ נָּ֥א לָכֶ֖ם חִידָ֑ה אִם־ הַגֵּ֣ד תַּגִּידוּ֩ אוֹתָ֨הּ לִ֜י שִׁבְעַ֨ת יְמֵ֤י הַמִּשְׁתֶּה֙ וּמְצָאתֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים סְדִינִ֔ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים חֲלִפֹ֥ת בְּגָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem šim·šō·wn ’ā·ḥū·ḏāh- nā lā·ḵem ḥî·ḏāh ’im- hag·gêḏ tag·gî·ḏū ’ō·w·ṯāh lî šiḇ·‘aṯ yə·mê ham·miš·teh ū·mə·ṣā·ṯem wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem šə·lō·šîm sə·ḏî·nîm ū·šə·lō·šîm ḥă·li·p̄ōṯ bə·ḡā·ḏîm
verses.literal: Let me tell . . . you a riddle Samson said to them If you can solve . . . it for me within the seven days of the feast I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes, pois, Sansão: Eu vos darei um enigma para decifrar; e, se nos sete dias das bodas o decifrardes e descobrirdes, eu vos darei trinta lençóis e trinta mudas de roupas.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֣א תוּכְלוּ֮ לְהַגִּ֣יד לִי֒ וּנְתַתֶּ֨ם אַתֶּ֥ם לִי֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים סְדִינִ֔ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים חֲלִיפ֣וֹת בְּגָדִ֑ים וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔וֹ ח֥וּדָה חִידָתְךָ֖ וְנִשְׁמָעֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯū·ḵə·lū lə·hag·gîḏ lî ū·nə·ṯat·tem ’at·tem lî šə·lō·šîm sə·ḏî·nîm ū·šə·lō·šîm ḥă·lî·p̄ō·wṯ bə·ḡā·ḏîm way·yō·mə·rū lōw ḥū·ḏāh ḥî·ḏā·ṯə·ḵā wə·niš·mā·‘en·nāh
verses.literal: But if you cannot . . . solve it you must give me thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes Tell us your riddle they replied Let us hear it
verses.literalPt: E, se não puderdes decifrar, vós me dareis a mim trinta lençóis e as trinta mudas de roupas. E eles lhe disseram: Dá-nos o teu enigma a decifrar, para que o ouçamos. 14 Então lhes disse: Do comedor saiu comida, e do forte saiu doçura. E em três dias não puderam decifrar o enigma.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם מֵהָֽאֹכֵל֙ יָצָ֣א מַאֲכָ֔ל וּמֵעַ֖ז יָצָ֣א מָת֑וֹק וְלֹ֥א יָכְל֛וּ לְהַגִּ֥יד הַחִידָ֖ה שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem mê·hā·’ō·ḵêl yā·ṣā ma·’ă·ḵāl ū·mê·‘az yā·ṣā mā·ṯō·wq wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū lə·hag·gîḏ ha·ḥî·ḏāh šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: So he said to them Out of the eater came something to eat and out of the strong came something sweet For three days they were unable . . . to explain the riddle
verses.literalPt: Verszeile ohne Text

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ לְאֵֽשֶׁת־ שִׁמְשׁוֹן֙ פַּתִּ֣י אֶת־ אִישֵׁ֗ךְ וְיַגֶּד־ לָ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־ הַ֣חִידָ֔ה פֶּן־ נִשְׂרֹ֥ף אוֹתָ֛ךְ וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית אָבִ֖יךְ בָּאֵ֑שׁ הַלְיָרְשֵׁ֕נוּ קְרָאתֶ֥ם לָ֖נוּ הֲלֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î way·yō·mə·rū lə·’ê·šeṯ- šim·šō·wn pat·tî ’eṯ- ’î·šêḵ wə·yag·geḏ- lā·nū ’eṯ- ha·ḥî·ḏāh pen- niś·rōp̄ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ wə·’eṯ- bêṯ ’ā·ḇîḵ bā·’êš hal·yā·rə·šê·nū qə·rā·ṯem lā·nū hă·lō
verses.literal: So on the fourth day they said to Samson’s wife Entice your husband to explain the riddle to us or we will burn you and your father’s household to death Did you invite us here . . . to rob us
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, ao sétimo dia, disseram à mulher de Sansão: Persuade a teu marido que nos declare o enigma, para que porventura não queimemos a fogo a ti e à casa de teu pai; chamastes-nos aqui para vos apossardes do que é nosso, não é assim?

verses.original: וַתֵּבְךְּ֩ אֵ֨שֶׁת שִׁמְשׁ֜וֹן עָלָ֗יו וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ רַק־ שְׂנֵאתַ֙נִי֙ וְלֹ֣א אֲהַבְתָּ֔נִי הַֽחִידָ֥ה חַ֙דְתָּ֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עַמִּ֔י וְלִ֖י לֹ֣א הִגַּ֑דְתָּה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֗הּ הִנֵּ֨ה לְאָבִ֧י וּלְאִמִּ֛י לֹ֥א הִגַּ֖דְתִּי וְלָ֥ךְ אַגִּֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·ḇək ’ê·šeṯ šim·šō·wn ‘ā·lāw wat·tō·mer raq- śə·nê·ṯa·nî wə·lō ’ă·haḇ·tā·nî ha·ḥî·ḏāh ḥaḏ·tā liḇ·nê ‘am·mî wə·lî lō hig·gaḏ·tāh way·yō·mer lāh hin·nêh lə·’ā·ḇî ū·lə·’im·mî lō hig·gaḏ·tî wə·lāḵ ’ag·gîḏ
verses.literal: Then Samson’s wife came to him weeping and said . . . You hate me You do not really love me You have posed to my people . . . . . . a riddle but have not explained it to me Look he said I have not even explained it to my father or mother so why should I explain it to you
verses.literalPt: E a mulher de Sansão chorou diante dele, e disse: Tão-somente me desprezas, e não me amas; pois deste aos filhos do meu povo um enigma para decifrar, e ainda não o declaraste a mim. E ele lhe disse: Eis que nem a meu pai nem a minha mãe o declarei, e to declararia a ti?

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤בְךְּ עָלָיו֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַיַּגֶּד־ לָהּ֙ כִּ֣י הֱצִיקַ֔תְהוּ וַתַּגֵּ֥ד הַחִידָ֖ה לִבְנֵ֥י עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·ḇək ‘ā·lāw šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer- hā·yāh lā·hem ham·miš·teh way·hî bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î way·yag·geḏ- lāh kî hĕ·ṣî·qaṯ·hū wat·tag·gêḏ ha·ḥî·ḏāh liḇ·nê ‘am·māh
verses.literal: She wept . . . the whole seven days - of the feast and finally on the seventh day because she had pressed him so much he told her the answer And in turn she explained the riddle to her people . . .
verses.literalPt: E chorou diante dele os sete dias em que celebravam as bodas; sucedeu, pois, que ao sétimo dia lho declarou, porquanto o importunava; então ela declarou o enigma aos filhos do seu povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לוֹ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הָעִ֜יר בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י בְּטֶ֙רֶם֙ יָבֹ֣א הַחַ֔רְסָה מַה־ מָּת֣וֹק מִדְּבַ֔שׁ וּמֶ֥ה עַ֖ז מֵאֲרִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם לוּלֵא֙ חֲרַשְׁתֶּ֣ם בְּעֶגְלָתִ֔י לֹ֥א מְצָאתֶ֖ם חִידָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lōw ’an·šê hā·‘îr bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bə·ṭe·rem yā·ḇō ha·ḥar·sāh mah- mā·ṯō·wq mid·də·ḇaš ū·meh ‘az mê·’ă·rî way·yō·mer lā·hem lū·lê ḥă·raš·tem bə·‘eḡ·lā·ṯî lō mə·ṣā·ṯem ḥî·ḏā·ṯî
verses.literal: Before sunset . . . on the seventh day the men of the city said to Samson What is sweeter than honey And what is stronger than a lion So he said to them If you had not plowed with my heifer you would not have solved my riddle
verses.literalPt: Disseram, pois, a Sansão os homens daquela cidade, ao sétimo dia, antes de se pôr o sol: Que coisa há mais doce do que o mel? E que coisa há mais forte do que o leão? E ele lhes disse: Se vós não lavrásseis com a minha novilha, nunca teríeis descoberto o meu enigma.

verses.original: וַתִּצְלַ֨ח עָלָ֜יו ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֗ה וַיֵּ֨רֶד אַשְׁקְל֜וֹן וַיַּ֥ךְ מֵהֶ֣ם׀ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ חֲלִ֣יצוֹתָ֔ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ הַחֲלִיפ֔וֹת לְמַגִּידֵ֖י הַחִידָ֑ה וַיִּ֣חַר אַפּ֔וֹ וַיַּ֖עַל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיהוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tiṣ·laḥ ‘ā·lāw rū·aḥ Yah·weh way·yê·reḏ ’aš·qə·lō·wn way·yaḵ mê·hem šə·lō·šîm ’îš way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ḥă·lî·ṣō·w·ṯām way·yit·tên ha·ḥă·lî·p̄ō·wṯ lə·mag·gî·ḏê ha·ḥî·ḏāh way·yi·ḥar ’ap·pōw way·ya·‘al bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·hū
verses.literal: Then the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him and he went down to Ashkelon killed . . . thirty of their men took their apparel and gave their clothes to those who had solved the riddle And burning with anger Samson returned to his father’s house
verses.literalPt: Então o Espírito do SENHOR tão poderosamente se apossou dele, que desceu aos ascalonitas, e matou deles trinta homens, e tomou as suas roupas, e deu as mudas de roupas aos que declararam o enigma; porém acendeu-se a sua ira, e subiu à casa de seu pai.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֖י אֵ֣שֶׁת שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן לְמֵ֣רֵעֵ֔הוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רֵעָ֖ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ’ê·šeṯ šim·šō·wn lə·mê·rê·‘ê·hū ’ă·šer rê·‘āh lōw
verses.literal: and his . . . wife was given to one of the men who had accompanied him
verses.literalPt: E a mulher de Sansão foi dada ao seu companheiro que antes o acompanhava.
